metrics.blocked_reason: prime-rl 0.7.0 (the pod image) rejects [model.vlm] for SFT: the SFT data path is renderer-only and tokenizes text-only message dicts client-side ('renderer-only SFT does not support VLMs yet'). GitHub main has removed this check and supports VLM SFT, so this is version drift, not a hard platform limit.
